findings.message: The stage 7 draft needs a refreeze before launch: drop src/main.ts and src/features/index.ts from its writes (ownership moved to stage 4), lift src/api from its forbiddenWrites and adopt the deletion of the four legacy api classes with its adapter files, keeping auth-feature and adapter protection until its own freeze.

requirementFit.summary: REQ maps to both acceptance criteria, evidence receipts, workstream ownership and final audit gates; the deletion set and its replacements are explicit.

implementationQuality.summary: Three audit rounds reached a complete import closure of the deletion set (pages, pages.ts, three controllers): every consumer is deleted or rewritten inside the 40-path write set, including the inputFile/avatar chain found in round 2; the api layer stays read-only for stage 7; composition-root rewiring is executable on the accepted stage 3 kernel.

evidenceQuality.summary: Compile-before-delete stays enforceable, the removable debt-map set is spelled out exactly (seven ui-type-api-import records plus the ChatUser half of Store.ts) and matches the live TRANSITIONAL_DEBT map.

residualRisk.summary: Round 1 and 2 blockers closed and re-verified (api preservation, shared components, inputFile/avatar, embed-spec sync, error pages kept by design); one LOW carry-forward about the stage 7 refreeze.

summary: Independent three-round read-only audit of revision 4. Round 1 (r2) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED: the deletion set broke the forbidden auth feature (runtime AuthApi import) and three shared components. Round 2 (r3) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED: the inputFile/avatar chain still imported the deleted controllers and the embedded specification block was stale. Round 3 (r4) verified all closures complete — cryptographically reconstructing the r3 digest from r4 to prove the delta is exactly as declared — confirmed the 404/500 keep-in-place decision, disjointness from accepted stages, the exact removable debt set and the no-production boundary. Revision 5 adds the two feature-boundary test paths (chats.test.ts, profile.test.ts) required by plan step 3 that revision 4 omitted from the write set; no other change. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
